reason: A web interface skin plugin that applies a user-selected background image and adapts theme colors, opacity, image fit, scrim, and light/dark behavior using documented theme APIs and localStorage.

summaries.zh: 通过用户选择的背景图片自动调整网页界面的主题色，并提供透明度、图片适配、遮罩和明暗模式设置。
summaries.en: Applies a user-selected background image to the web interface and adapts theme colors with controls for opacity, image fit, scrim, and light or dark mode.

capabilities: applies a background image to the web interface
derives light and dark theme color tokens from the image palette
provides controls for opacity, image fit, scrim, and light/dark behavior
stores image data and settings in localStorage
registers a settings page for skin configuration
